2. **Free One-Day Delivery**: Available in thousands of eligible cities and zip codes on select items when ordered by the specified cutoff time to receive items by 9:00 PM the following day.
3. **Free Same-Day Delivery**: Available in select metropolitan areas on qualifying orders over $25 (orders under $25 incur a $2.99 delivery fee for Prime members) when ordered in the morning before 12:00 PM noon for delivery by 9:00 PM the same day.
4. **Amazon Day Delivery**: Choose a designated day of the week to receive all weekly orders grouped together in fewer boxes at no extra charge.
5. **No-Rush Shipping**: Select "FREE No-Rush Shipping" at checkout to earn promotional rewards or instant discounts to spend on digital products, eBooks, or future eligible orders once the package ships.
